findings.title: R88 missing from role-universe routing prefixes
findings.evidence: agent/src/stockpred/fund_rotation/batch_service.py:372-386 and agent/scripts/run_r81_combination_batch.py:29-44 list role prefixes through R87 but omit ai_rotation_r88_r81_role_r60_gate.
findings.impact: An R88-only request routes through snapshot.universe_codes rather than snapshot.role_universe_codes, violating role-only execution scope and potentially excluding current R81 representatives. The R87-vs-R88 pair masks this because R87 already triggers the role pool.
findings.minimal_fix: Append the exact R88 prefix to the existing role-prefix tuples in batch_service.py and run_r81_combination_batch.py; add an R88-only routing regression without changing PIT or execution semantics.

findings.title: Missing future-row invariance test
findings.evidence: R88 tests verify a pre-signal row is excluded but do not perturb post-signal rows and compare results.
findings.impact: The causal implementation is present, but this important regression boundary is not directly locked by a test.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a test that changes post-signal bars/adjustments and asserts the 126-day result is unchanged.

findings.title: Session-level artifact consistency is not directly tested
findings.evidence: Implementation patches the final decisions artifact diagnostics, but the R88 test suite only checks helper diagnostics and pipeline metadata.
findings.impact: A future regression could desynchronize returned diagnostics and persisted decisions evidence without failing the current focused tests.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a minimal session fixture asserting the returned medium_trend_gate equals the corresponding decisions artifact entry.

tests_reviewed: 55 passed: R88, R87, R86, economic-role, and strategy-catalog focused regression suite
residual_risks: No long paired backtest was run per instruction.
Research-only and RESEARCH_ONLY_UNVERIFIED_UNIVERSE caveats remain applicable.
Windows pytest cache/temp ACL warnings are environmental.
